name: Mudhi Mansa
ingredients: 500g mutton (goat meat) cut into medium pieces
instructions: 1. Heat mustard oil in a pressure cooker until smoking, then add bay leaves and sliced onions. Sauté until golden brown.
2. Add ginger-garlic paste and cook for 2 minutes. Stir in turmeric, chili powder, coriander powder, and cumin powder.
3. Add the mutton pieces and sear them on medium-high heat until they turn brown and release their moisture.
4. Pour in the tomato puree and salt; sauté until the oil separates from the masala base.
5. Add a cup of water, cover the cooker, and pressure cook for 4-5 whistles or until the meat is tender.
6. Once the steam escapes, sprinkle garam masala and garnish with fresh coriander.
7. To serve, place a generous portion of puffed rice (Mudhi) in a bowl and ladle the hot, spicy mutton curry directly over it.
description: Mudhi Mansa is the signature culinary delight of the Mayurbhanj district in Odisha. It combines the rustic crunch of puffed rice with a spicy, flavorful mutton curry. It is a popular street food and household comfort dish, often enjoyed during local festivals and social gatherings.
